description: Build a .gitignore by combining the website's templates for languages, frameworks, mobile, game engines, tools, OSes and editors (node, python, java, android, ios, flutter, reactnative, unity, unreal, go, rust, cpp, dotnet, php, wordpress, rails, django, nextjs, vite, docker, terraform, macos, windows, linux, vscode, jetbrains, vim). Templates can be named by id, name or keyword (e.g. "javascript" → node). Duplicate patterns are removed, optional "### Name ###" section headers, plus your own custom lines at the end. Returns the text, or writes it to "output" (e.g. "./.gitignore"). Set "list" to see all templates. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/gitignore-gen/

custom.description: Extra lines to append in a "Custom" section.

dedupe.description: Drop patterns that already appeared in an earlier section. Default true.

headers.description: Add a generated-by header, section headers and template comments. Default true.

list.description: Just list the available templates (id, name, group, keywords).

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

templates.description: Templates to combine, in order, e.g. ["node", "nextjs", "vscode", "macos"].

name: gitignore_generate
title: Generate .gitignore
